To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) the use of alternate frequency bands, particularly an orange band, in addition to the standard green band improves PPG signal extraction from a digital camera; and (b) the use of a combination of cyan and green bands (CG) provides better results than the use of green alone (G), and a combination of cyan/green/orange (CGO) provides better results that CG.
the use of a five band camera with cyan, green and orange bands (CGO) is better than RGB for remote measurement of heart rate and heart rate variability.
the use of a five band camera, including a cyan, green and orange band, can provide accurate remote measurement of cardiopulmonary parameters.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the use of digital cameras to measure cardiopulmonary parameters remotely, without contact, and in an unobtrusive way.
the development of low cost, unobtrusive, non-contact, remote measurement of cardiopulmonary activity for healthcare and affect computing.

improving remote measurement of physiological signals from digital cameras and we present results that demonstrate that the inclusion of alternate frequency bands, particularly an orange band, can significantly improve the quality of the measurement.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the five band camera is a promising approach for the remote measurement of cardiopulmonary signals.
this is the first demonstration that a five band digital camera, in combination with a novel algorithm, is a viable approach for measuring cardiopulmonary parameters in real-time.
the five band camera is superior to the RGB camera, and the CGO camera is superior to all the other five band cameras.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have demonstrated that the five band camera has great potential for remote physiological monitoring and can be used to provide accurate heart rate, breathing, and heart rate variablity measurements.
the use of a five band camera with alternate frequency bands, specifically an orange band, allows for remote physiological measurements with high correlations to contact measurements.
we have demonstrated that it is possible to obtain accurate and reliable PPG measurements using only ambient light and a low cost, off the shelf camera.

a five band camera, with a combination of CGO, can be used to measure cardiopulmonary signals with high fidelity.
a simple, low-cost digital camera can be used to make accurate measurements of the blood volume waveform, heart rate, breathing and heart rate variability.
remote PPG measurement is feasible and can be done with existing cameras and software.
